## scheduled-task

A component that runs to completion on a schedule. Source: [addons/openchoreo-platform/files/cluster-component-types/scheduled-task.yaml](../../addons/openchoreo-platform/files/cluster-component-types/scheduled-task.yaml). Workload type: cronjob. Allowed traits: none. Allowed workflows: dockerfile, elixir, go, nextjs, ruby.

### parameters

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `activeDeadlineSeconds` | integer |  | `300` |  |
| `backoffLimit` | integer |  | `3` |  |
| `concurrencyPolicy` | string |  | `Forbid` |  |
| `failedJobsHistoryLimit` | integer |  | `1` |  |
| `restartPolicy` | string |  | `OnFailure` |  |
| `successfulJobsHistoryLimit` | integer |  | `3` |  |
| `timeZone` | string |  |  |  |

### environmentConfigs

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `imagePullPolicy` | string |  | `IfNotPresent` | One of `Always`, `IfNotPresent`, `Never`. |
| `resources` | any |  |  |  |
| `schedule` | string |  | `1 * * * *` |  |

## service

A long-running request-serving component with one or more endpoints. Source: [addons/openchoreo-platform/files/cluster-component-types/service.yaml](../../addons/openchoreo-platform/files/cluster-component-types/service.yaml). Workload type: deployment. Allowed traits: health-probes, horizontal-pod-autoscaler, keda-scaler, observability-alert-rule, persistent-volume-claim. Allowed workflows: dockerfile, elixir, go, nextjs, ruby.

### environmentConfigs

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `imagePullPolicy` | string |  | `IfNotPresent` | One of `Always`, `IfNotPresent`, `Never`. |
| `replicas` | integer |  | `1` | Range 0... |
| `resilience` | object |  | `{}` |  |
| `resilience.nodePool` | string |  | `""` |  |
| `resilience.preStopSleepSeconds` | integer |  | `5` | Range 0... |
| `resilience.terminationGracePeriodSeconds` | integer |  | `30` | Range 1... |
| `resilience.zoneSpread` | string |  | `ScheduleAnyway` | One of `ScheduleAnyway`, `DoNotSchedule`. |
| `resources` | any |  |  |  |

## web-application

A long-running component that serves web requests and exposes at least one HTTP endpoint. Source: [addons/openchoreo-platform/files/cluster-component-types/webapp.yaml](../../addons/openchoreo-platform/files/cluster-component-types/webapp.yaml). Workload type: deployment. Allowed traits: health-probes, horizontal-pod-autoscaler, keda-scaler, observability-alert-rule, persistent-volume-claim. Allowed workflows: dockerfile, elixir, go, nextjs, ruby.
